title: Office Party Board
seo_title: Office Party Charcuterie Board for 15–25: Shopping List & Plan
description: An office party charcuterie board for 15–25: crowd-pleasing, allergy-aware and zero fuss. Cheddar, turkey, salami, grapes, a gluten-free cracker option and no peanuts.
hook: Twenty people, a conference table and nobody's dietary needs written down. This board plays it safe on purpose: familiar food, labeled options, no peanuts.
why: At work you don't know who eats what, so every choice is the one most people are happy with. Cubed cheddar and turkey are the safest picks for a mixed crowd, and pepperoni and salami cover the rest.

It's built to be allergy-aware. The gluten-free crackers sit on their own, away from the others, the nuts contain no peanuts, and the carrots, tomatoes and grapes give everyone something to eat. A bowl of ranch makes the vegetables disappear.

timeline.what: Set up the board or table surface.
Cube the cheese; open all the packages.
Place the cheeses, dips and mustard.
Add meats and fruit; crackers go on last.

faq.q: How much charcuterie do I need for 20 people at work?
faq.a: About 28 oz of cheese and 20 oz of meat for 15–25 people as a snack, plus crackers, fruit and vegetables.

faq.q: How do I make an office board allergy-friendly?
faq.a: Keep gluten-free crackers on their own section of the board, leave peanuts off, and put a small label by anything with nuts.

faq.q: Can I set it up the night before?
faq.a: Cube the cheese and slice the meat the night before and keep them sealed in the fridge. Assemble the board an hour before the party.
